posts.title: Do We Still Need Agile?
posts.description: Agile was invented to solve a specific problem: software development was slow, expensive, and wrong. The waterfall process — full requirements, full design, full implementation, then test and discover you built the wrong thing — routinely produced systems that were over budget, late, and didn't match what users actually needed.
